0xA2F3 = 1010 0010 1111 0011
0xF000 = 1111 0000 0000 0000 
1010 0000 0000 0000 >> 12 
Result = 0000 0000 0000 1010 or A in HEX and 10 in Decimal 

0x6B20 & 0x0F00 >> 8
0x6B20 = 0110 1011 0010 0000
0x0F00 = 0000 1111 0000 0000

1011 >> 8 = 0000 0000 0000 1011 = B or 11 in decimal 

0x3122 & (0x00F0, 0x0FF0, 0x0FFF) >> 8 

0x3122 = 0011 0001 0010 0010
0x0F00 = 0000 1111 0000 0000

0000 0001 0000 0000 >> 8 = 

0x223B & 0x0FF0 
0x223B = 0010 0010 0011 1011
0x0FF0 = 0000 1111 1111 0000

0000 0010 0011 0000 >> 0 = 230 in HEX and 560 in decimal ?
